QuestInfo.name: Meaning of Regret 2
QuestInfo.0: Sorcerer wants to speak with you. Go see the Sorcerer.
QuestInfo.1: Sorcerer want you to guess what he is looking at through the test again. Go face your feelings of regret in #b#MDmirrorD_328_1_##k.
QuestInfo.2: You let the meaningless regrets pass by in #MDmirrorD_328_1_#.

0.0: Truthfully, I'm still a little skeptical. I can still see familiar things in your mind...pain, rage, despair... These are all elements of regret. That's why I want you to pass another test. I want to see what you're seeing now.

yes.0: Return to #b#MDmirrorD_328_1_##k to find #r#t4009116##k and #r#t4009117##k. Then you'll know the true face of your regrets. Make sure they do not get the better of you.

no.0: Nothing will change if you keep running.

1.0: How'd it feel to face your regrets? You really don't have a shred of regret left?

yes.0: Your efforts have been quite admirable. Continue your quest, and think not for a minute of the decisions that pass.

default.0: Find #r#t4009116##k and #r#t4009117##k items to see what's really in your heart.
